title:
POV: I TOLD A SHOP OWNER IN ISRAEL
I WAS HUNGRY AND HAD NO MONEY
beats: THE TEST: 'Salamu Alaikum. I have a question - I'm really hungry, but I don't have any money. Can you help me?'
'Yes.' 'Really? For free?' 'Yes.' 'Are you Muslim?' 'Yes - my name is Mustafa.' 'I'm Tal. I'm Jewish. I love you.' 'We are brothers.'
THE REVEAL: 'Actually, I do have money. This is for you.' 'No, no, no.'
'I was testing your kindness. You don't want the money?' 'No, thank you.' 'Why?' 'I don't know.'
'Are you Palestinian?' 'Yes.' 'This is Palestinian culture.' 'I'm Israeli.' 'We are together. Inshallah. Salam and shalom.'
THE ENDING: 'Habibi. Shukran. I'll take this bread and give it to someone who needs it.'
